prompt: Use case: style-transfer. Asset type: high-resolution 2D game background tile atlas, native Godot remake. Edit target: the supplied original Green Brinstar BG2 atlas extracted from the user's Super Metroid ROM. Primary request: redraw the existing indigo-blue organic cave wall, twisted roots and rock fragments with crisp hand-painted detail, depth and subtle blue-violet highlights while faithfully keeping the original artwork layout. This is a technical texture atlas, NOT a scene or screenshot. Composition invariants: exact 2:1 aspect ratio; preserve every existing cluster's position, extent, orientation and silhouette; preserve all empty black cells and the empty black upper left area. The source is a 16-column by 8-row grid of 8x8 native tile cells, enlarged proportionally; keep the cell grid locations fixed, do not rearrange or join separated clusters, do not add separators, margins or gutters. The larger connected dark blue root/rock cluster fills most of the lower half; the small isolated blue clusters stay at the same upper right locations. Improve detail inside the existing shapes, preserving the dark near-black background and subdued blue palette suitable for distant scenery. Orthographic flat asset sheet; no perspective. No characters, doors, platforms, UI, labels, text, watermarks or new objects. Keep seams between adjacent original pieces coherent so the native game can assemble the same wall.
description: Hand-painted replacement of the 66 decoded Green Brinstar main-shaft BG2 tiles. Native 16-column atlas, tile IDs and flips remain authoritative; source black gaps retained.
